name: Additive Waveform
desc: An oscilloscope of Fourier synthesis where stacked lanes of faint spectral sine harmonics (low=red to high=violet) sum into one bright gold composite that perpetually morphs between sawtooth, square and organic timbres as harmonic amplitudes and phases drift.

name: Agate
desc: A slabbed and polished agate read as a macro plate — growth bands of chalcedony marching inward from the cavity wall in milk, honey and carnelian, a druzy quartz vug crowding the last of the void, dark basalt in the corners, and the whole section quietly changing shape because the lapidary is still advancing the cut.

name: Aizawa Attractor
desc: A luminous Aizawa strange attractor integrated tens of thousands of steps per frame into a glowing density field, its gold polar spiral threading a slowly-tumbling indigo spherical shell that rotates on two incommensurate axes and never repeats.

name: Algal Bloom
desc: Filamentous green algae blooming and crashing in a lit water column — unbranched Spirogyra threads elongate by intercalary division with helical chloroplast ribbons winding inside their sheaths, trapped oxygen rafts the tangled mats toward the surface, then the nutrients run out, the filaments go yellow, fragment and sink as detritus that remineralises and starts the whole cycle again.

name: Ammann Bars
desc: The hidden decoration of a quasicrystal laid bare — five families of heavy engraved bars whose gaps follow the Fibonacci musical sequence LSLLSLSLL, struck dark and confident across a toned board, crossing into a pentagrid whose cells shade into a six-tone aperiodic mosaic while a raking light wanders the plate and occasional phason flips jump a single bar by phi.

name: Ammann-Beenker
desc: An eightfold aperiodic quasicrystal of silver-ratio squares and 45-degree rhombi grown by 4D cut-and-project, slowly rotating beneath a luminous highlight that travels the Ammann-bar grid, rendered as jewel-toned tiles, Escher stained glass, neon lattice, cyan blueprint, or austere sumi ink.

name: Anisotropic Diffusion
desc: Perona-Malik edge-preserving diffusion runs backwards against a drifting noise forcing so structure crystallizes out of static — flat plateaus condense and enlarge while their grain boundaries stay razor-crisp and migrate forever, never settling; rendered as a false-colour micrograph with etched boundaries, an edge-lit radiograph, hatched ink lithography, ironbow thermal, or pure specular chrome relief.

name: Apollonian Gasket
desc: A self-similar Apollonian gasket grown by the Descartes circle theorem, its mutually-tangent circles nesting into every curved gap and breathing depth-by-depth as gilded gold-leaf coins, neon rings, a cyan blueprint, misregistered riso duotone, or chiaroscuro spheres.

name: ASCII Rain
desc: Cascading terminal glyph-columns of phosphor rain that periodically self-organize into a hidden word or glyph before dissolving back into digital noise.

name: Strange Attractor Cloud
desc: A dense, glowing Peter de Jong strange-attractor point-cloud whose silky indigo-to-gold filaments accumulate 40-70k iterates per frame into a log-density buffer and morph forever as their coefficients drift and precess — rendered as silk, psychedelic plasma, molten ember, deep-sea bioluminescence, or a graphite pencil study.

name: Aurora Ribbons
desc: Full-bleed polar-night sky where layered noise waves luminous aurora curtains that drift and shimmer above a seeded starfield.

name: Baker's Mixing
desc: Chaotic advection caught mid-fold — two pigments pulled through an alternating sine flow that stretches and folds them like taffy into razor-thin lamellae, exponentially finer every pass, while elliptic islands of unmixed fluid ride serenely inside the chaos and never blend at all; as pigment lamellae in a dark bath, banded agate strata, a mixing-intensity field that shows only where the fluid is working, sumi ink marbling, or an iridescent oil film.

name: Bark Galleries
desc: Engraved under the bark — a mother gallery runs the grain laying egg niches while larval tunnels fan off perpendicular, widening as the larvae grow and never once crossing each other's path, ending in pupal chambers; then the brood emerges, the galleries weather away and a new colony attacks.

name: Barnsley Fern
desc: The iconic Barnsley fern grown by a chaos game of four affine maps, its self-similar fronds accumulating in luminous height-graded green (deep base to chartreuse tips), swaying on the clock and re-sprouting variant ferns each section, with autumn, bioluminescent, frost, and sumi-ink alternates.

name: Benard Convection Cells
desc: Rayleigh-Benard convection seen from above, integrated as the Swift-Hohenberg equation the real thing reduces to near onset — a fluid heated from below organizes into a honeycomb of hexagonal convection cells with hot rising cores and cool sinking rims, or into rolls, or into spiral-defect chaos where grain boundaries glide and defects nucleate and annihilate without ever settling; false-colour thermal, planetary magma crust, hammered bronze relief, drafting blueprint, or sumi ink.

name: Bifurcation Diagram
desc: The logistic-map fig-tree fractal: a single line forking to 2, 4, 8 and cascading into a chaotic haze shot through with periodic windows, hued cool where stable and hot where chaotic, a phosphor scan-bar sweeping the r-axis while the window slowly pans and zooms into self-similar detail.

name: Traffic Automaton
desc: A Biham-Middleton-Levine traffic cellular automaton where red and blue cars self-organize into striking diagonal free-flow bands on a dark road, tipping into gridlock jams as the section builds.

name: Black Hole Accretion
desc: A gravitationally-lensed black hole: a Doppler-beamed accretion disk of white-hot orange fading to violet swirls around a dark event-horizon shadow ringed by a glowing photon ring, an orbiting hotspot breaking the symmetry over a faint lensed starfield.

name: Blancmange Curve
desc: Parallax bands of the nowhere-differentiable Takagi/blancmange fractal stacked back-to-front as a spectral mountain-fabric, each crinkled ridge scrolling and shivering as its triangle-wave octave phases drift.

name: Boids Flock
desc: Hundreds of distinct triangular boids run Reynolds' separation-alignment-cohesion to cohere, split and merge into wheeling murmurations that dart from a roving predator, each arrow hued spectrally by its heading over a dusk-gradient sky with faint motion trails — switchable to pale-sky starling silhouettes, an additive neon swarm, warm pulsing fireflies, or dry sumi ink.

name: Braided River
desc: A braided gravel-bed river seen from above — water threads scour where the flow concentrates and dump gravel where it slackens, so mid-channel bars build and split the flow into an anastomosing web that re-weaves itself continuously; a bar that grows too tall shoves its own thread aside, floods drown the whole braid and reset it, and low stage re-incises the threads through pale gravel that vegetation is slowly colonising.

name: Brushed Metal
desc: A machined metal panel under a shop lamp that will not hold still — the anisotropic highlight smears perpendicular to the brush grain and travels as the lamp orbits, wandering satin grain on a slightly oil-canned face, breaking into a rotating dark cross on a sunburst disc or a field of planished facets under the hammer.

name: Brusselator Cells
desc: An autocatalytic Brusselator reaction-diffusion medium whose chemistry breathes edge-to-edge — indigo-teal-yellow-red concentration cells that pulse as Turing spots, expand as target waves, and shear into oscillating stripe domains that never settle.

name: Buddhabrot
desc: A ghostly Buddhabrot apparition — the accumulated escape trajectories of the Mandelbrot iteration paint a luminous, slowly-breathing nebula of blue-cyan-gold density on deep space, also rendering as blackbody ember, escape-count spectral rainbow, violet ghost, or bone-white monochrome.

name: Burning Ship Fractal
desc: A slow cinematic drift through the eerie Burning Ship fractal rigging — antenna masts and self-similar armadas rendered in flickering smooth-iteration flame, ice, toxic acid, posterized rainbow bands, or a monochrome engraving.

name: Excitable-Medium Spirals
desc: A FitzHugh-Nagumo excitable-medium chemistry where emergent rotating spiral waves and expanding target rings sweep the frame, colliding and annihilating like a living Belousov-Zhabotinsky chemical clock - painted in vivid blue-cyan-yellow-magenta reagent, bioluminescent teal, thermographic blackbody, pink-violet litmus, or bare hue-driven wavefront contours.

name: Cairo Pentagons
desc: The Cairo pentagonal pavement caught mid-morph — a single parameter breathes the whole one-parameter family, sliding the tiling from diagonal squares through the true 120/90 Cairo pentagon to basketweave rectangles while the plane drifts and turns beneath it.

name: Capillary Ripples
desc: Rain on still water, rendered by its dispersion: because surface tension carries short waves faster than gravity carries long ones, every impact ring turns inside out — a hair-fine fringe of capillary ripples sprints out ahead while the fat swell it was born with lags behind and the water inside falls quiet again; as a dark pond mirroring a bright sky, a false-color map of the local wavelength, liquid mercury, optical iso-fringes, or a sumi ink pond.

name: Water Caustics
desc: A luminous rippling net of light filaments dances across the whole frame like sunlight focused on a pool floor, bright cyan-white caustics interweaving over teal-indigo depths and endlessly flowing; renders as bright pool, bioluminescent deep-sea, golden sunlit sand, thermal false-color, or a named grayscale.

name: Cellular Automata
desc: A coarse life-grid ticks forward on every beat while its ruleset mutates each section — Conway to HighLife to Day&Night — rendered as glowing green CRT phosphor with scanline roll and blinking cursor.

name: Celtic Knotwork
desc: Endless interlaced Celtic knotwork of over-under woven cords threading a grid of crossings, perpetually re-threading as multi-hue bands drift and undulate — rendered as gilt illuminated-manuscript, neon glow-weave, carved stone relief, woven tartan, or black-on-cream ink.

name: Chladni Cymatics
desc: Cymatic Chladni figures — sand settling on the nodal lines of a vibrating plate as superposed standing-wave modes beat against each other, the resonance web perpetually morphing to finer symmetric lattices as the driving frequency climbs; renders as gold sand on indigo, phosphor oscilloscope, spectral-tinted plate, ferrofluid, or black sand on cream.

name: Chua Double-Scroll
desc: Chua's-circuit double-scroll strange attractor: a slowly rotating butterfly of dense filament windings whose trajectory hops between a magenta scroll and a cyan scroll across a glowing gold bridge, breathing as its diode parameter drifts.

name: Circle Packing
desc: A poster field of seeded circles grown until they kiss their neighbours, each dot cycling through bloom-and-pop on staggered phases while the limited palette rotates a hue every musical section.

name: Clifford Attractor
desc: A Clifford strange attractor iterated tens of thousands of points per frame into a silky log-density cloud threaded with delicate moire striations, its four coefficients drifting so the whole filigree form morphs and slowly turns, glowing indigo-to-gold on dark or recast as magenta-cyan plasma, blackbody ember, teal bioluminescence, or graphite pencil on cream.

name: Cloth Flag
desc: A spring-mesh flag rippling on a traveling-wave wind with fold-shaded cloth, gusts kicked by the bass, and looks that range from a solid banner to stripes, a rising-sun ensign, checker, an exposed wireframe mesh, and a halftone dot render.

name: Cloud Chamber
desc: A Wilson cloud chamber raked by a sheet of light — ionizing particles condense their paths out of supersaturated vapour: fat alpha stubs fanning off a source pin, thin cosmic muons falling clean through, and low-momentum electrons curling into tight spirals in the magnetic field, every track fattening and diffusing away seconds after it is born.

name: Collatz River
desc: Hundreds of Collatz (3n+1) hailstone orbits braid out from a shared root into a luminous river-delta of coral strands, hued violet-young through cyan to gold-old with additive glow, swaying on incommensurate currents over deep glowing water.

name: Colonnade
desc: A hypostyle hall walked forever — a depth-sorted forest of fluted stone columns whose ranks slide across each other into fleeting alignments, architraves running overhead to the vanishing point, and a pool of clerestory light wandering the slabs ahead.

name: Columnar Basalt
desc: Looking straight down on a cooling lava sheet that has cracked itself into hexagons — column tops sit at their own heights as ball-and-socket plateaus, vesicles pit the rind, chipped rubble wedges into the joints, and a low raking sun crawls around the pavement while a wet front sheets across and dries away behind it; weathered causeway, hard-broken quarry stone, moonlit basalt, false-colour relief or a hatched survey plate.

name: Conchoidal Fracture
desc: A flint core being knapped, blow by blow — glassy stone breaks in shells, so every strike drives a Hertzian cone that peels a flake away and leaves a hollow bulb of percussion behind it, ringed with concentric ripple marks that widen as they run and combed with fine radial hackle, each fresh scar slicing clean through the older ones while the chalky white cortex creeps back over everything the knapper has not touched lately.

name: Living Constellations
desc: A deep night sky that visibly wheels overhead — blue-white stars sweep across the frame with parallax drift while cyan and gold constellation lines lace and dissolve, shooting stars streak past, and a faint drifting nebula glows behind it all.

name: Game of Life
desc: Conway's B3/S23 automaton boiling edge-to-edge — gliders sail from planted Gosper guns, chaotic soups reseed the dying regions, living cells burn hot-to-cool by age with a fading ember-ghost trail of the recently dead.

name: Copperplate Engraving
desc: An old-master burin plate: a draped ovoid volume modelled entirely out of line — swelling hatch ribbons that bend to follow the surface they describe, cross-hatched to solid black in the shadow and thinning to bare paper on the lit crown, the drapery folds breathing while a raking studio lamp crawls slowly around the form.

name: Corona Layers
desc: One interlocking tile, ringed by its own coronas out to the frame edge — the shape writhes and re-carves its own silhouette continuously yet every neighbour still locks in without a hair of gap, while rings of state change ripple outward layer by layer under an orbiting light.

name: Coronal Rain
desc: An arcade of magnetic loops standing off the limb in the extreme ultraviolet, glowing hardest at the feet where the heating is — until an apex loads up with too much mass to stay hot, catastrophically cools, and condenses into blobs that cannot fall straight down because they are threaded on the field, so they hang at the top where gravity along the field line is zero, creep, and then plunge into whichever leg they happened to condense on, while the loops themselves ring in the kink mode and the diffuse corona drifts around them.

name: Corridor
desc: An endless one-point-perspective corridor dollying forward forever — ribbed concrete bays sweep past, doorways open and close on the walls, and a raking light wanders down the shaft toward the lit portal at the vanishing point.

name: Coulomb Charges
desc: Hundreds of positive and negative point charges drift across a toroidal field and self-organize into glowing ionic lattices, dipole chains and alternating +/- clusters — warm gold cations and cool cyan anions bonded across the whole frame.

name: Craquelure
desc: An ageing surface tearing itself apart — crack tips run along the stress field, arrest dead against older cracks in perfect T-junctions and branch into ever-finer generations, while raking light sweeps their lifted edges and the oldest fractures sink slowly back under the varnish.

name: Curl-Noise Smoke
desc: Thousands of luminous motes advected through an incompressible divergence-free curl-noise field, folding into turbulent filaments and vortices like ink drifting in water, in warm ember, indigo ink, teal aurora, bright spark-storm, or graphite pencil-flow.

name: Cutaway Section
desc: An endless architectural cross-section trucking sideways forever — storeys stacked over a cut grade line, poché-black structure driving down through topsoil, gravel, clay and bedrock to a service tunnel, lit windows breathing in every room.

name: Cyanotype Photogram
desc: Specimens laid on a hand-coated sheet through a twenty-minute exposure — nothing holds still that long, so each one smears its own penumbra into the Prussian blue as it drifts, the coating's brush edges and mottle printing right along with them, the tray forever washing the whole thing back.

name: Cyclic CA Spirals
desc: A Greenberg-Hastings cyclic cellular automaton that self-organizes from noise into rotating rainbow pinwheels and demon-eye target waves tiling the whole frame, rendered as full-hue pinwheels, warm ember, cool ocean, two-ink duotone, green phosphor CRT, or bright wavefront contours.

name: Dadras Attractor
desc: A dense chaotic Dadras attractor woven into a graceful multi-lobed swirling ribbon-knot that tumbles on two incommensurate rotation rates, its density and depth log-mapped from magenta through cyan to white-hot glow on a deep ground.

name: Damascus
desc: A billet of pattern-welded steel read as a contour map of its own folding — hundreds of laminated layers cut open by the ground face, the nickel standing proud and bright where the ferric bite has sunk the carbon steel to near-black, while a raking light crawls the plate and the highlight travels band by band.

name: Data-scape
desc: A Ryoji-Ikeda / Alva-Noto data console: crisp monochrome barcode strips, quantized spectral bars, oscilloscope waveforms and ticking hex columns stacked into registers and raked by a scanning cursor, the whole field reshuffling and brightening with the musical arc; renders as white-on-black data, amber CRT, cyan blueprint schematic, RGB-datamosh glitch, or green phosphor terminal.

name: Delaunay Flux
desc: A living low-poly web whose Delaunay triangulation is rebuilt every frame from a cloud of drifting points, so triangles flex, edges flip and cells breathe while centroid-position hue paints the mesh from an iq cosine palette under bright glowing edges.

name: Delta Lobe
desc: A river delta builds itself into a standing basin — sediment parcels walk the bed downhill, incise channels on the plain and settle at the mouth into bars that split the flow, so distributaries branch outward on their own; the lobe superelevates until the trunk avulses to a new one, and a slow rise and fall of sea level drowns and re-progrades the whole plain, so the basin never fills.

name: Differential Growth
desc: A closed curve that ceaselessly subdivides and repels itself into ever-more convoluted brain-coral folds, a thick coral-and-teal ribbon writhing and growing edge to edge before reseeding as a fresh organism.

name: Advected Dye
desc: Vivid magenta, cyan and gold dye injected into a slowly stirring bath and smeared by a two-scale curl-noise flow into marbled ribbons and paisley swirls, rendering as marbled ink on a dark bath, iridescent oil-on-water thin-film, black-indigo suminagashi rings on cream, glowing astro nebula emission, or high-key candy pastels.

name: Directional Solidification
desc: An alloy pulled through a thermal gradient: the flat freezing front is unstable, so it buckles into an array of cells whose tips race ahead into richer liquid while surface tension fights back, and the array never settles - cells split, drift and get squeezed out in Kuramoto-Sivashinsky chaos as the selected spacing wanders; the solid keeps the record, so the cell grooves trail away downward as the microstructure with the pulling rate laying horizontal bands through it, read as a false-colour phase field, an etched longitudinal section, Nomarski relief, or a blueprint of groove trajectories.

name: Animated Dither
desc: A slow smooth field of drifting sine terrain rendered through an ordered 8x8 Bayer matrix into crisp chunky print dots, coverage pumping with rms and the pattern boiling / drifting / rippling, in 1-bit / amber-phosphor / blueprint / newsprint / thermal-false-color inks.

name: DLA Crystal
desc: Diffusion-limited aggregation grows dendritic frost from a seed as living random-walk motes stick and branch, restarting each couple of sections, in icy-frost, warm-coral, sumi-ink and phosphor-circuit renderings.

name: Complex Domain Coloring
desc: A living phase portrait of a complex rational function whose drifting poles and zeros bloom into glowing rosettes, the argument painting a full phase-wheel of hue while the modulus carves concentric contour rings and radial rays across the plane.

name: Doodle World
desc: A wobbly hand-drawn landscape that draws itself stroke by stroke over a section then keeps boiling forever - hills, a rayed sun, a little house, a tree and dancing stick figures - rendered as graphite pencil, bold ink, waxy crayon, blueprint, chalkboard or neon scribble.

name: Doppler
desc: Moving sources tearing through a still medium, solved exactly: the retarded-time quadratic is evaluated at every pixel, so the wavefronts bunch tight and blueshift ahead of each source and stretch out redshifted astern with the colour read straight off the true Doppler factor, and once the ensemble walks past Mach 1 a silent zone opens with a sonic-boom cone tangent to every front — a fine mid-key thicket of interference fringes on an instrument slate, never a flash.

name: Double Pendulum Chaos
desc: A fan of dozens of double pendulums released from nearly identical angles diverges into chaos, their bob tips tracing luminous curling ribbons that start as one bright bundle then scatter into a spectral spray of sensitive dependence, re-released each section.

name: Drapery
desc: A heavy cloth hanging in deep folds with no outline anywhere — the whole form is carved out by a single raking light that drifts across the catenary ridges, sinking the valleys to near-black while the crests catch and the weave tooth breaks up every surface.

name: Drip Paint
desc: Threads of poured paint fall under gravity with whippy jitter, streaking and splattering into a tangled Pollock-esque field that pools and re-layers as new colors are flung each section.

name: Droste Spiral
desc: An Escher 'Print Gallery' Droste effect: a synthetic banded source wound through a conformal log-polar mapping into an infinite self-similar spiral that zooms and twists inward forever, rendered as hue-cycling spectral bands, nested Escher checker tiles, glowing neon veins, hard black-and-white op-art, or oil-slick iridescence.

name: EEG Montage
desc: A twenty-channel polysomnogram drawing itself across the chart paper: posterior alpha waxes and dies as the patient drops from wake into N2, sleep spindles and K-complexes fire under the pen, eye-movement channels swing hard in REM and blink artifacts punch through the frontals — the whole montage restaging itself every section.

name: Eikonal Wavefronts
desc: The eikonal equation solved by fast sweeping: first-arrival wavefronts race outward from drifting seeds through a heterogeneous medium, refracting around slow lenses, racing down fast channels, folding into caustic cusps and colliding into shock seams where two fronts meet — arrival-time isochrones ripple perpetually outward as false-colour travel-time tomography, blazing caustics, a muted bathymetric chart, dense interference fringes, or ironbow thermal.

name: Elementary CA Spacetime
desc: A 1D elementary cellular automaton (Wolfram rules 90/30/110/... drifting by section) evolved row-by-row and streamed endlessly upward, its nested triangles and fractal veins age-colored across phosphor terminal, ink-on-paper, amber CRT, spectral, and thermal false-color looks.

name: Encaustic
desc: Pigmented beeswax built up in fused layers you can see down through — each stroke veiled in milk by the clear wax laid over it, the whole slab never quite setting so the marks creep, while a heat gun keeps orbiting the panel and everything it passes bleeds at the edges, levels, and comes up wet.

name: Fourier Epicycles
desc: A luminous chain of nested rotating epicycle circles whose tip traces a glowing gold spirograph curve into a bright decay-trail, the harmonic coefficients drifting so the figure endlessly reinvents itself; renders as a spectral phosphor glow, hue-cycled neon, warm gold, a cyan construction blueprint, or sepia ink-plot.

name: Escapement
desc: A clock movement plate where a Graham deadbeat escapement actually works — the escape wheel sits dead still under the pallets, then runs exactly half a tooth as the pendulum sweeps through centre, the going train grinds round behind at its real reductions, the mainspring uncoils in the barrel, and a live oscillogram traces the arc along the bottom of the sheet.

name: Exploded Assembly
desc: An exploded axonometric of a machine that never finishes coming apart — flanges, gears, springs and nuts drift off a dash-dot centreline and drop back together while the whole assembly turns on its axis under ballooned leader lines.

name: Faraday Waves
desc: A vertically-vibrated fluid surface that spontaneously patterns into a shimmering lattice of standing-wave cells — squares, hexagons, stripes and quasicrystal tilings pulse and re-tile under backlit teal-and-indigo water with bright caustic crests.

name: Fatigue Striations
desc: A fatigue fracture surface read under the microscope: a crack born at a corner flaw creeps outward in nested clamshell beach marks, one shallow arched shell per load block creased by an arrest line, spacing widening exactly as the growth rate does, ratchet steps radiating from the origin — and everything the crack never reached stays as the matte dimpled crater-field of the final overload, shrinking as a raking electron beam wanders the plate, until the specimen lets go and re-etches onto a fresh one.

name: Feedback Paint
desc: A lush video-feedback paint field where bright brush blobs are advected, swirled and zoomed by a drifting noise flow into marbled multi-hue paint that fills the frame edge to edge, offered as vivid marbled paint, iridescent oil-slick, thermal ember-flow, bleeding ink-in-water, or electric neon veins.

name: Feedback Tunnel
desc: An infinite video-feedback tunnel where a bold faceted ring and rotating spokes are copied back scaled-up and rotated every frame, spiralling endless echoes outward to the edges as a spectral vortex, neon kaleidoscope, thermal infrared, monochrome strobe, or iridescent oil-slick.

name: Ferrofluid Spikes
desc: A pool of oil-black ferrofluid bristling into the iconic hexagonal Rosensweig spike array under a pulsing magnetic field, its sharp 3D peaks rising, migrating and merging while each catches an iridescent petrol-and-gold rim and a white-hot specular tip.

name: Fibonacci Grid
desc: Two Fibonacci chains crossed into a quasiperiodic brickwork — every column and every row spaced long-short in the golden ratio, cutting the plane into four kinds of inlaid panel that each keep their own hatch discipline, sliding and flipping as the chains drift out of step.

name: Firefly Synchrony
desc: A meadow swarm of pulse-coupled firefly oscillators that drift and twinkle at random then spontaneously entrain into unison waves of amber-green bloom, sync converging and breaking as coupling breathes across the arc.

name: Flow-Field Ribbons
desc: Long silky streamlines traced through an evolving Perlin flow field and drawn as translucent tapering ribbons that braid and layer into a wind-swept, sunset-lit fabric, forever reseeding as the field rotates and scrolls.

name: Flow Field Streams
desc: Thousands of particles streaming through an evolving curl-noise flow field leave luminous additive trails that fill the frame with silky spectral rivers, also rendered as green aurora curtains, molten ember, indigo ink on pale, or electric neon.

name: Forage Trails
desc: Ant-colony stigmergy in the open — several nests work an annulus of ground, foragers lay recruitment pheromone that other ants follow, sharpening aimless searching into hard trunk trails out to the food caches, until each cache drains, its trail evaporates away and the whole network rewires onto fresh ground; it never converges and never settles.

name: Forest-Fire CA
desc: A Drossel-Schwabl forest-fire cellular automaton where green woodland regrows, lightning kindles glowing orange-yellow fire fronts that sweep through connected forest and burn to smoldering ash, in self-organized-critical waves that never settle.

name: Windblown Tree
desc: A recursive L-system tree grows a full canopy and sways in an ever-changing wind — branches forking to luminous blossom/leaf tips that flicker, the whole crown bending under incommensurate gusts so it never repeats; renders as pink blossom, autumn fire, bioluminescent night-tree, bare winter frost, or sumi ink on paper.

name: Fraunhofer
desc: The far-field diffraction plate from an optical bench — a coherent beam through a slit, a double slit, an N-slit grating, a circular iris or a hex stop, printing its true Fraunhofer pattern in real spectral orders where blue diffracts least and red flares widest, the mount turning and the iris breathing over minutes; switchable to a single-wavelength laser exposure, a schematic iso-intensity contour plot, an ironbow detector readout, or a Sabattier-solarized print with Mackie lines rimming every order.

name: Galton Board
desc: Glowing beans cascade down a triangular peg lattice, bouncing left and right into a growing bell-curve histogram that builds, drains, and refills — probability made visible as neon columns, molten gold, thermal false-color, green phosphor, or a cyan wireframe blueprint.

name: Gantry
desc: A descent through a dark industrial volume laced with steel catwalks — grated decks and handrails cross the void at a dozen depths and rise past the eye as the camera sinks, clamped work lamps bloom in the haze, and a shaft of light leans through the corrugated dark.

name: Gauge Wall
desc: A control-room board of analog instruments: moving-coil needles overshoot and settle against engraved scales, counter drums roll their digits over, edgewise meters creep into the red, annunciator lamps latch and glow, and a miniature recorder inks its own trace while a raking room light crawls across the brushed panels.

name: Gear Train
desc: A machine-drawing plate of a working epicyclic reduction unit — sun, orbiting planets and a fixed internal ring whose teeth genuinely mesh, a compound spur chain wandering off through the coupling, dash-dot centrelines and chain-line pitch circles, and a title block whose shaft-speed readout shifts ratio every section.

name: Giant Rotating Word
desc: One huge word extruded into pseudo-3D, slowly turning on its axis so the depth-shaded slabs sweep across a dark stage, letters jittering on the treble; slab, wireframe, chrome-iridescent, neon-tube, halftone or x-ray depth.

name: Girih Tiling
desc: Interlaced Islamic girih star-and-polygon strapwork on deep lapis, its gilt double-ribbon lattice slowly rotating and breathing while a luminous highlight travels the ribbons and the palette drifts, in illuminated-gold, stained-glass, neon, stone-relief, or sumi-ink renderings.

name: Glacier
desc: A valley glacier system seen from above — ice piles up above the snowline and streams down its troughs, rock spalled off the valley walls rides on its back, and where two tributaries merge their debris stripes weld into a medial moraine that runs the length of the tongue; the snowline wanders over minutes so the terminus advances and retreats, stranding a new moraine arc at every stand while the ice grinds its trough deeper.

name: Glass Refraction
desc: The view through a pane of irregular glass — hand-blown crown rondels, fluted reeds, hammered dimples or a shattered sheet — each cell dragging the colour field behind it into a different place, fringing at the steep edges, with the lead came dark between and specular seams crawling as the pane drifts.

name: Volumetric God Rays
desc: Crepuscular light shafts pour from an off-screen source through drifting volumetric haze, flickering and sweeping as dust motes catch the beams; renders as warm cathedral light, underwater god-rays, neon lasers, thermal false-color, or noir monochrome.

name: Gosper Flowsnake
desc: The hexagonal Gosper flowsnake draws itself as one continuous glowing thread with a spectrum gradient running along its arclength, a comet-head sweeping the self-similar snowflake lattice while the whole figure slowly rotates and its recursion depth breathes; renders as spectral snake, electric neon filament, hammered gold-leaf, cyan blueprint schematic, or dry-brush sumi ink.

name: Grain Growth
desc: A Potts-model polycrystal annealing under the microscope: grain boundaries creep toward their centre of curvature, big grains devour their small neighbours and triple junctions pull to 120 degrees, while waves of recrystallisation seed fresh strain-free nuclei that sweep through and consume the coarsened structure so it never settles; shown as a petrographic thin section under slowly crossed polars, an EBSD orientation map, a greyscale etched-and-polished metallographic section, or a bare boundary network in blueprint.

name: Gray-Scott Turing
desc: A living Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion field where two chemicals react into spots, coral, fingerprint mazes and self-replicating mitosis blobs, forever growing and dividing as feed/kill march a ring of regimes over minutes; rendered as a vivid teal-to-hot-pink coral ramp, an x-ray bone radiograph, blackbody thermal, mossy terrarium, or black fingerprint ink on cream.

name: Ukiyo-e Wave
desc: A Hokusai great-wave off Kanagawa that rises and crashes once per bar with parametric claw-foam spirals over drifting cloud streaks and a snow-capped Fuji, in Prussian-blue woodblock, aged sepia, brushed sumi, dark storm, or a cyan schematic-contour blueprint.

name: Guilloche
desc: Rose-engine guilloche: interlacing epitrochoid rings + a nested rosette engraved as bright metallic filigree on deep petrol — precessing security-print lattice, edge to edge.

name: Gumowski-Mira Attractor
desc: A Gumowski-Mira strange attractor whose nonlinear recurrence breeds swirling mandalas, insectoid shells and galactic filaments that perpetually morph as a and b drift, its log-density point cloud glowing magenta-to-cyan on a deep indigo ground.

name: Haboob
desc: A wall of dust bearing down on a desert plain — parallax curtains of ochre stack far to near with real aerial perspective, Kelvin-Helmholtz rolls boil along the leading edge, torn streamers race across the foreground and the sun slowly drowns behind it as the wall closes, engulfs and passes over minutes.

name: CMYK Halftone
desc: A drifting domain-warped source separated into cyan/magenta/yellow/black and screened through rotated dot grids at the classic 15/75/0/45 angles, beating into a full-color moire rosette print texture that boils and slowly turns like wet newsprint.

name: Halvorsen Attractor
desc: The cyclically-symmetric Halvorsen strange attractor integrated at 65k steps a frame and splatted into a slowly self-rotating fading density buffer, its spiralling triple-lobed shell of dense filaments glowing violet-to-cyan-to-gold, or recast as iq-cosine plasma, molten ember, glacial ice, or graphite pencil hatching.

name: Harmonograph
desc: Three superimposed damped-pendulum harmonographs weave glowing spectral Lissajous roulettes with a thick additive halo and bright core, their frequencies precessing continuously so the figure forever re-draws itself; renders as spectral glow, molten gold, electric neon, cyan blueprint, or monochrome ink.

name: Helicorder Drum
desc: A seismograph drum turning under its stylus: twenty hours of trace wrap around a smoked cylinder and scroll away into the limb, the pen scratching live microseism at the front while earthquakes arrive as P-then-S bursts whose codas clip across three lines at once, and the helix steps down forever overwriting the oldest hour.

name: Hex Cellular Automaton
desc: A six-neighbor cyclic cellular automaton on a hexagonal honeycomb lattice that self-organizes from noise into rotating six-fold snowflake fronts and crystalline spiral waves tiling the whole frame, rendered as iridescent crystal rings, amber honeycomb, blue-white ice, radioactive green, or an etched hex engraving.

name: Hopalong Attractor
desc: Barry Martin's Hopalong map iterated tens of thousands of times per frame into a log-density histogram, painting vast swirling square-ish galactic sheets and interference-like curved lattices that slowly rotate and re-weave — teal-to-amber glow on dark, plasma, blackbody ember, icy blue, or graphite pencil.

name: Hopf Links
desc: Stereographically projected Hopf fibers — great-circle rings of the 3-sphere that link without ever touching, nested into a luminous torus of spectrum-hued glowing loops tumbling in continuous 4D rotation.

name: Hydraulic Erosion
desc: Rain carves a living mountain range — droplets incise dendritic drainage into a heightfield while tectonic uplift pushes back, so ridges sharpen, rivers capture one another, and whole ranges rise and wear away over minutes.

name: Hyperbolic Tiling
desc: A Poincare-disk hyperbolic tessellation in the spirit of Escher's Circle Limit, its {p,q} jewel-toned tiles shrinking in infinite regress toward the boundary while a slow Mobius drift and elliptic spin make them stream endlessly outward, rendered as backlit stained glass, carved woodcut, a glowing neon lattice, or two-tone op-art moire.

name: Fractal Flame
desc: An electric-sheep fractal flame born from a chaos game of affine maps folded through sinusoidal, swirl, horseshoe and handkerchief variations, accumulated into a log-density histogram and gamma tone-mapped into luminous drifting tendrils over a breathing indigo ground — switchable to thermal heat-map, sumi ink on paper, oil-slick iridescence, or silver burin engraving.

name: Impossible Architecture
desc: A slowly turning axonometric lattice of cuboid bar-frames that cannot exist — each frame's farthest strut is repainted over the strut it just passed behind, so the occlusion runs in a cycle and the structure reads as solid and as a lie at once, with stair treads climbing runs that reset where you cannot see.

name: Wave Interference
desc: Overlapping ripple sources bloom concentric rings that collide into shimmering moire lattices; the sources orbit slowly while ring spacing breathes on the swell and treble sets the fringes vibrating, in moire / thermal-false-color / blueprint-contour / iridescent-plasma / posterized-duotone renderings.

name: Magnetic Field Lines
desc: Iron filings tracing the writhing field of drifting magnetic dipoles, streamline slivers curling into bipolar arcs and cusps and clustering hot at the poles, graded cool-weak to incandescent-dense.

name: Ising Spin Domains
desc: A 2D Ising ferromagnet flickering near its critical temperature — indigo and gold spin domains nucleate, coarsen and dissolve behind glowing writhing walls as the lattice is slowly swept from frozen order through fractal criticality into hot noise.

name: Isometric City
desc: A breathing dusk metropolis of seeded isometric towers that scrolls endlessly past the camera, windows twinkling on and off while traffic light-streaks race the streets, blimp-clouds drift, and a sun-moon sweeps a slow day-night arc across a blue-violet skyline.

name: Jacquard
desc: A weaving draft that is actually being woven — threading diagram over the warp, tie-up square, treadling column, and a drawdown where the cloth grows pick by pick at the fell as a shuttle flies across, warp and weft floats catching the light in colour-and-weave stripes, and every section the loom is re-drafted so the pattern changes above the fell line.

name: Morphing Julia Set
desc: A connected, filled Julia set whose seed constant orbits the main cardioid so the whole fractal perpetually morphs from fat spiraling lobes to seahorse filaments, its non-escaping interior glowing electric blue-violet while gold escape filaments trace the boundary.

name: Kaleidoscope
desc: A live kaleidoscope where a wandering ink emitter is folded into N-fold dihedral symmetry every frame over a slowly spinning, zooming feedback buffer, blooming an endlessly evolving symmetric mandala-in-motion whose fold count steps by section.

name: Von Karman Vortex Street
desc: Flow past a hidden obstacle sheds alternating counter-rotating vortices that peel off into the classic staggered double row, warm and cool dye streaming downstream to reveal the swirling wake — as vorticity-tinted dye on dark fluid, grey schlieren shadowgraph, blue-to-white thermal false-color, indigo ink-in-water, or glowing neon flux.

name: Karst
desc: A cave system dissolves itself into limestone in cross-section — water sinks through a fabric of vertical joints and bedding planes, and because a wider fissure takes more flow it widens faster and captures its neighbours, so a few conduits win and open into passages; the water table falls over minutes, strands the tube it cut, and starts a new one below it, while the drained tiers above grow dripstone.

name: Kelp Forest
desc: A giant-kelp forest running its conveyor — the meristem at each blade's base extrudes tissue continuously while the distal tip erodes away, so corrugations stream forever up the blades and vanish at their ends; gas bladders float the stipes into a flattened surface canopy, wave surge rolls the whole forest with an orbital motion that dies away with depth, and new sporophytes recruit on the rock as old ones let go and wash out of frame.

name: Kelvin-Helmholtz Billows
desc: Two dyed fluid layers slide past each other and roll their shear interface into the iconic train of breaking cat's-eye billows, curling and advecting forever on the clock as warm cloud over cool sky, teal ocean foam, thermal false-color, indigo ink, or luminous aurora curtains.

name: Kleinian Limit Set
desc: An Indra's-Pearls Kleinian-group limit set: two Mobius maps spin an infinite necklace of nested tangent pearls and fractal dust that breathes between a loose chain and dense self-similar froth, depth-hued and glowing on dark.

name: Koch / Dragon Fractal
desc: A thick spectral fractal curve that morphs between Koch snowflake, Levy C and Heighway dragon families, filled as a faint luminous body and stroked with a glowing hue-along-length line that slowly rotates and breathes.

name: Kolam / Sona Loops
desc: A symmetric South-Indian kolam that threads smooth continuous chalk loops around a glowing grid of pulli dots, drawing itself outward from the centre and re-blooming into a fresh endless-knot pattern every few bars.

name: KPZ Growth
desc: A thin film growing in cross-section: vapour arrives along a beam and sticks to the first material it grazes, so tips capture the flux and shadow their neighbours, the front roughens into the self-affine Kardar-Parisi-Zhang interface, and the buried film keeps the record as tilted columns, overhangs and voids while the beam's glancing angle swings and chevrons them; the substrate scrolls away beneath forever, read as a greyscale cross-section SEM, deposition-time stratigraphy, an absorption radiograph, or a blueprint of the void network.

name: Kuramoto Sync
desc: A lattice of coupled Kuramoto phase-oscillators that spontaneously synchronizes out of random noise into flowing rainbow phase-domains, rotating spirals and sweeping traveling waves — a shimmering map of collective synchronization, rendered as full-hue phase-wheel, cool ocean, warm ember, hard two-ink duotone, or bioluminescent iso-phase veins.

name: Unicursal Labyrinth
desc: The classical unicursal labyrinth — one path, no junctions, no choice — cut as a worn channel into a full-frame pavement of jointed limestone, its lit and shadowed lips swapping sides as a lamp rakes slowly across the floor, while lit walkers thread the Cretan level sequence circuit by circuit toward a six-petal rosette and the whole floor precesses under them.

name: Langton's Ant Colony
desc: A colony of Langton's ants crawls a coarse lattice, each turmite flipping cells by a section-drifting turn-rule and dragging a fading colored trail that tangles into churning chaos and bursts of diagonal highway order until the over-built grid collapses and reseeds, rendered as neon highways, green phosphor CRT, ink plotter, thermal visit-heatmap, or copper circuit traces.

name: Lava Lake
desc: Plate tectonics running in fast-forward on a lava lake — a divergent flow field tears the black crust open along incandescent ridges, new skin is born there and rafted outward cooling from white-hot through orange to basalt, and where plates collide the margin founders and is swallowed, so the whole surface is created and destroyed forever; rendered as molten blackbody rind, a seafloor magnetic-anomaly age plate, ironbow thermal, or sumi ink.

name: Leather
desc: A hide at follicle scale that will not stop working — pebble grain domed between its creases, a bend wave travelling through so the crease network bites shut and opens again, dye pooled dark in the valleys and rubbed off the crowns, and the abraded high points showing the pale corium underneath.

name: Lenia Lifeforms
desc: Bert Chan's Lenia — a continuous cellular automaton whose smooth ring-kernel convolution and Gaussian growth breed glowing orbium-like creatures that glide, pulse, split and self-organize across the field; renders as bioluminescent deep-sea blooms, thermal, green cell-membrane, magenta plasma, or dark sumi ink on cream.

name: Locked Forme
desc: A forme locked up in the chase and printed with real bite — blocks of type colour, brass rules, wood-type slabs with punched counters and ornament borders, every face haloed by its own impression as a raking lamp crawls over the deboss, ink squashing out at the edges and starving in the middle of the big faces while the damp stock cockles under the platen.

name: Library Stacks
desc: A camera trucking sideways along a wall of library stacks — each aisle swings open as you pass it, throwing a deep one-point vista of shelved spines converging on a lit window at its dead end, then a stack end swallows it again and the next one opens.

name: Line Integral Convolution
desc: Line integral convolution — a fixed noise texture smeared along the streamlines of a drifting divergence-free flow so the whole frame becomes one silky combed fabric of visible flow lines, the convolution kernel phasing in real time so the texture streams without a single particle being drawn; false-colour flow-viz keyed to speed, burnished graphite, oil-black iridescence, hard engraved contour bands, or ironbow thermal.

name: Lichen
desc: Crustose lichen colonies creep across dark granite — sulphur-yellow, rust-orange, sage and near-black species each stopping dead where they touch a neighbour, so a hard seam opens between them and the raised living margins glow around every territory, laying zonation rings as they age and dying out from the necrotic centre to free the stone for fresh propagules, the whole mosaic swelling and saturating as moisture cycles.

name: Lichtenberg Figure
desc: A dielectric-breakdown burn that accretes from a hot seed, forking into ever-finer feathery tendrils that spread to fill the frame like captured lightning frozen in acrylic, then softly regrows — as violet-white electric plasma, cyan captured-acrylic, amber woodburn, white frost-on-glass, or a mono ink print.

name: Liesegang Rings
desc: Periodic precipitation in a gel: reagent invades from a pipetted source, meets the loaded gel and reacts into a soluble product that stays clear until it passes supersaturation and suddenly drops out as a band - which strips the product back down, so the front must run on and re-supersaturate before it can band again, laying discrete rings of widening spacing rather than a smooth stain; new sources keep arriving so ring systems collide and interfere, read as ochre bands in translucent gel, banded agate, scattering rings in dark field, or a blueprint of contours.

name: Lightning
desc: Multiple branching violet-white bolts fork out of a dim storm sky and re-strike frequently, each with a near-white hot core inside a wide colored glow, flickering and fading to afterglow while the cloud briefly flashes — recolorable as crimson, ice-blue, toxic-green, or a flat cyan schematic blueprint.

name: Linkage
desc: A drafting plate of working four-bar mechanisms, each figure in its own ruled cell — cranks turn, rigid coupler triangles tumble, rockers swing on hatched ground pivots, and every coupler point drags a bright pen-head around the closed roulette it is cutting; each section the plate re-drafts one figure and the new curve draws itself in.

name: Lissajous Grid
desc: A full-bleed oscilloscope wall of Lissajous figures — one glowing curve per cell at an integer frequency ratio (column = x-freq, row = y-freq) — the whole matrix precessing on a drifting phase term so every cell morphs open to closed forever; renders as a spectral-scope rainbow, green phosphor CRT, amber terminal, white-on-blue blueprint, or electric neon.

name: Locust Marching Bands
desc: Thousands of marchers, each only steering toward whoever is within a body-length of it — crowd them past the threshold and order condenses out of the gas as a solitary band, a hard dense front that sweeps the frame and evaporates back into shimmering grain, drawn only ever as density, never as insects.

name: Lorenz Attractor
desc: A Lorenz/Rossler/Thomas strange attractor integrated in 3D and accumulated into a slowly self-rotating fading density buffer, its butterfly wings glowing in speed-and-depth color as plasma ribbon, thermal false-color, sumi ink, cyan blueprint schematic, or pearlescent oil-slick.

name: Lorenz-96 Ring
desc: A scrolling Hovmoller space-time diagram of the Lorenz-96 toy-climate: a ring of coupled variables breeds travelling wavefronts of spatiotemporal chaos that sweep and merge across the frame, forcing drifting from ordered waves into full turbulence as the sections build.

name: Low-Poly Mesh
desc: A drifting low-poly triangulation whose facets flip and shimmer, each flat-shaded by its own normal against a slowly sweeping light so the surface reads as a faceted jewel catching moving glints.

name: L-System Garden
desc: A lush wind-swept garden of L-system plants — ferns, weeds and flowering sprigs grown from branching rewrite rules, filling the frame with luminous foliage and colored blossoms that sway on incommensurate breezes and reseed new species each section.

name: Lyapunov Fractal
desc: A Markus-Lyapunov 'Zircon Zity' fractal where the logistic map is driven by an alternating AB-sequence of two growth rates, its per-pixel Lyapunov exponent painting swooping biomorphic teal-and-gold ridges over a dark chaotic sea while the (a,b) window slowly pans, zooms, and re-strings section by section.

name: Magnetic Pendulum Basins
desc: A magnetic-pendulum basin fractal where every pixel releases a damped pendulum tugged by a slowly rotating ring of magnets and is coloured by which magnet captures it, so vivid attractor pools churn along infinitely filigreed boundaries — also rendered as molten settle-time thermal, soft pastel, glowing boundary-only neon, or four-tone hatched ink.

name: Sand Mandala
desc: A radially symmetric sand mandala that constructs wedge-by-wedge from the center outward, holds, then dissolves in a wind sweep of blown grains, rendered as stippled Tibetan colored sand, black line rangoli, leaded stained glass, glowing neon, or a cyan compass-and-radius blueprint.

name: Escape-Time Fractal
desc: A live Julia escape-time fractal whose c-parameter orbits a slow circle and breathes a gentle zoom so the smooth-iteration filigree endlessly morphs, rendered as glowing warm embers, electric-blue lightning, a copperplate contour engraving, iron thermal false-color, or time-cycled psychedelia.

name: Mandelbrot Deep Zoom
desc: A perpetual slow-rotating deep zoom into the Mandelbrot boundary that continuously magnifies toward a seeded interesting point, revealing ever-new self-similar filigree as a cycling spectral palette descends with it, rendered as electric spectra, molten ember, glacial ice, saturated psychedelia, or a mono copperplate engraving.

name: Ink Marbling
desc: Full-bleed suminagashi where concentric ink drops bloom, comb strokes shear the pattern, and a slow curl current advects the whole marble across the paper.

name: Martensite
desc: A diffusionless military shear caught mid-avalanche: lenticular plates snap into the austenite along their habit planes at the speed of sound, each with a midrib and internal twins, each stopping dead where it strikes another plate, and because the strain at a plate tip triggers the next one they arrive in autocatalytic cascades that partition the parent grains hierarchically into ever finer self-accommodating wedges - then the specimen is cycled around its hysteresis loop and the plates reverse last-formed-first; read as an etched metallographic section, tint-etched variant colour, latent-heat thermal, or a blueprint of habit-plane traces.

name: Glyph Rain
desc: Falling columns of luminous dot-matrix glyphs cascade down the screen with white-hot leading heads and phosphor-fading tails that flicker and mutate as they drop — classic Matrix digital rain rendered in green, amber, ice-cyan, rainbow, or skeletal bone.

name: Maurer Rose
desc: A Maurer rose weaves 360 straight chords across a drifting r=sin(nθ) rose into a perpetually morphing star-lattice / celtic-knot filigree, hue-gradient neon threads glowing over a faint filled bloom; renders as spectral lattice, gold-leaf foil, electric neon, cyan blueprint schematic, or dry sumi ink.

name: Growing Maze
desc: A perfect maze carves itself in real time via randomized recursive-backtracker growth, the hot carving head snaking corridor by corridor through the grid until a glowing solver floods the solution path, then it dissolves and a fresh maze grows — rendered as a cool neon circuit board, a technical blueprint, a red Ariadne thread on cream, a sunlit hedge garden, or a torch-lit dungeon.

name: Meander Migration
desc: A lowland river writhes across its own floodplain — bends grow and crawl downstream under upstream-weighted curvature until a neck closes and severs a loop into an oxbow lake, and every channel position it ever held is printed into the plate as arcuate scroll bars in the ink of its era, so a whole alluvial history accretes and is slowly buried; Fisk alluvial plate, false-colour satellite, sepia survey sheet or cyanotype schematic.

name: Metaball Mercury
desc: Luminous liquid-metal metaballs merge and split as seven charges orbit, an implicit field banded into chrome-teal-to-magenta iso-shells with a bright specular highlight so the molten blobs glow against a dim indigo ground.

name: Mezzotint Ground
desc: A copper plate rocked all over until it prints solid velvet black, then burnished back into light — heavy volumes surface out of the dark with no outline at all, only a raking lamp crawling across them, the burr grain never quite scraped away.

name: MHD Filaments
desc: Magnetic field lines frozen into a moving plasma, dragged and stretched wherever the fluid goes until anti-parallel bundles are crushed together into blade-thin current sheets that finally cut and re-splice — reconnection — flinging the ropes apart to be stirred and crushed again; as luminous filaments threading a dim plasma, a signed current-sheet map, a solar EUV coronal plate, brushed ink contours, or spectral false-color.

name: Spirit Duplicator
desc: Copies landing in the delivery tray of a ditto machine — a typed and hand-drawn master coming off the drum in aniline purple, each sheet skewed a little further and a little fainter than the last, drum streaks and starved edges and the ghost of the sheet underneath, until the master gives out and a fresh one goes on.

name: Mirage
desc: A landscape seen through air that will not hold a straight line — a scorching floor thins the layer above it until light skims up off nothing and lays a sheet of false water across the ground, or a cold inversion bends the rays down over the horizon and hauls distant ridges up into the towering stacked and inverted castles of a Fata Morgana; every ray is traced through the actual refractivity profile, and thermal turbulence shreds the image into shimmer.

name: Mobius Transform
desc: A conformal Mobius transformation endlessly warps a colored checker grid on the complex plane, bending straight lines into circles as elliptic and loxodromic flows swirl the whole field toward and away from two drifting fixed points.

name: Moiré Weave
desc: Two-to-four families of thin parallel threads — straight razor gratings or watered-silk waves — rotate at slightly different rates and slide out of register, blooming shimmering moiré interference bands that breathe and sweep across the frame, rendered as Bridget-Riley black-and-white op-art, neon duotone, thermal false-color, cyan blueprint, or warm risograph misprint.

name: Moss Mat
desc: A macro study of moss and liverwort fighting for a slab of rock — compact acrocarpous cushions spread in every direction while thalloid liverwort runs in forking ribbons along its own axis, sporophyte setae rise from mature turf and nod their ripening capsules until they dehisce, and necrotic centres collapse back to bare stone for the spore rain to recolonise.

name: Motility Jam
desc: A suspension of swimmers with no attraction between them at all jams itself solid anyway — each one slows down where its neighbours are thick, slow things pile up, piles slow things further, and the crowd unmixes into a dense jammed phase with a rough evaporating edge floating in its own fizzing gas.

name: Munching Squares
desc: The classic PDP-1 munching squares reborn in color: (x XOR y) bit-patterns cascade as nested squares that interleave, pulse and munch through a vivid cyclic palette, morphing between XOR, AND and multiplicative moire across sections — pure bit-pattern hypnosis rendered as rainbow interference, green phosphor CRT, amber terminal, thermal false-color, or a hard black-and-white bit-field.

name: Muqarnas
desc: Looking straight up into the crown of a muqarnas vault — tier on tier of faceted stalactite niches honeycombing outward from a slowly turning rosette, each pocket sinking back into shadow as a raking light rakes around the dome and a bloom climbs through the cells.

name: Mycelium
desc: A fungal colony feeding — apical hyphae split, fuse and thread outward through a nutrient field, then autolyse behind the advancing margin as the medium is exhausted, so the network perpetually colonises, starves, dies back and recolonises the plate.

name: Spiral Galaxy N-Body
desc: A rotating N-body disk galaxy — hundreds of gravitating stars seeded on logarithmic spiral arms wind through differential rotation into luminous trailing arms around a glowing core, perpetually shearing and re-forming; renders galactic blue-to-amber, plasma, firefly, blackbody heat, or monochrome vector-trails.

name: Nematic
desc: A nematic liquid crystal under a polarising microscope: the director field tangles into the classic schlieren texture where dark brushes sweep out of every half-integer disclination, birefringence washes the terraces in interference colour, and pools of isotropic melt open and re-order as the temperature drifts through the transition - each quench throwing a fresh crop of defects that hunt, pair off and annihilate; offered as crossed polars, a raw director streak field, a false-colour order-parameter map, or a blueprint of the disclination cores.

name: Newton Fractal
desc: A Newton-method root-basin fractal for z^n minus one whose roots slowly orbit and whose over-relaxation coefficient swirls, so saturated stained-glass basins churn along their infinitely-filigreed boundaries — also rendered as polished metallic chrome, a cyan blueprint of boundary lines, iron thermal false-color, or hatched monochrome ink.

name: Newton's Rings
desc: A convex lens pressed onto an optical flat, photographed close — the wedge of air trapped between them interferes with itself into Newton's rings, dark at the contact point and running out through the true reflected-light colour sequence until the source's coherence gives out and the orders wash to grey; the bench drifts, so the fringes march, and the optic under test can be swapped for a tilted flat, a cylinder, or a real aspheric with zonal error and astigmatism written into its interferogram.

name: Topographic Contours
desc: A slowly heaving topographic map whose elevation contour lines and shaded relief bands drift and reshape like a living cartographic survey; renders as a colour elevation map, cyan blueprint isolines, thermal false-color, black-ink contours on cream, or glowing neon rings.

name: Oil Slick Iridescence
desc: Thin-film interference iridescence where a domain-warped thickness field bends light into slowly crawling spectral bands like petrol on wet asphalt, mapped through per-channel cosine interference; renders as dark saturated oil-on-water, airy soap-film pastel, metallic beetle-shell jewel, smooth thermal false-color, or pearlescent nacre.

name: Op-Art Warp
desc: A precision black-and-white Vasarely grid deformed by an invisible lens that orbits the frame, cells magnifying and twisting into a breathing sphere-illusion dome.

name: Orrery
desc: A luminous clockwork cosmos where a warm radial sun anchors jewel-hued planets sweeping elliptical orbits ringed in glowing brass, with moons, a long-tailed comet, and slowly rotating armillary bands over a deep nebula-lit starfield.

name: Orthographic
desc: A general-arrangement plate of a bossed bracket in true orthographic projection — plan, front and side elevations laid out in first or third angle with heavy visible outlines, dashed hidden bores, dash-dot centrelines and arrowheaded dimensions whose numbers keep changing because the part itself is slowly morphing, while an isometric pictorial turns in the fourth quadrant.

name: Ostwald Ripening
desc: An emulsion coarsening under the objective: curvature makes small droplets more soluble than large ones, so the big quietly eat the small, drifting drops coalesce on contact, and every dissolved droplet hands its mass back to the matrix until the supersaturation fires off a fresh burst of nucleation - a dispersion that cycles forever instead of settling; rendered as a lit emulsion micrograph, luminous refracting rims in dark field, a grey phase-contrast plate, or ironbow thermal.

name: Pack Ice
desc: A drifting ice pack failing from altitude — the plate breaks along conjugate shear lines, so wherever the wind pulls it apart a lead rips open to black water and immediately starts skinning over with dark nilas, and wherever it shoves back together the floes raft and pressure ridges pile up bright and throw long blue shadows under a sun that never rises; true-colour aerial survey, speckled radar backscatter, close nilas with frost flowers, rotten summer ice pooling cyan, or a flat ice-chart classification.

name: Parking Ramp
desc: A helical parking deck driven forever — the camera corkscrews and climbs so the whole structure banks around it, mushroom columns and sodium tubes whip past, and daylight cuts through the spandrel slots between the parapet and the deck one turn overhead.

name: Patina
desc: A metal plate corroding in real time: oxidation nucleates, creeps outward against the grain of the alloy, ripens through tarnish into crust, spalls off in flakes to bare fresh metal, and runs mineral stain down the face — while a raking light finds only the parts still bright.

name: Patterned Ground
desc: Periglacial ground sorting itself — freeze-thaw cycling drives stones apart from silt into polygonal nets on the flat crown that stretch out into downslope stripes on the flanks, the whole pattern creeping steadily downhill under a low raking arctic sun.

name: Penrose Tiling
desc: An aperiodic Penrose P3 rhombus quasilattice grown by deflation into a fivefold sun of gold-and-bronze rhombs on deep indigo, slowly turning while a luminous inflation-front sweeps the tiles outward, in gilt-manuscript, drafting blueprint, neon strapwork, riso duotone and sumi-ink renderings.

name: Invasion Percolation
desc: Fluid invades a random-threshold porous medium always through the weakest available pore, growing a ramified fractal cluster that strands dark trapped voids like oil fingering through rock, colored by invasion time from early violet to late gold and perpetually dissolving to regrow on fresh geology.

name: Petal Unfurl
desc: A dense herbarium plate of flowers opening by differential growth rather than by keyframe — the adaxial surface outgrows the abaxial until each petal's curvature reverses through zero and the bud reflexes itself open, stamens tremble at anthesis, then turgor fails, the ribbons go slack and the petals abscise one by one to leave a bare receptacle for the next bud; sixteen blooms staggered across the sheet at depth, so something is always unfurling and something always shedding.

name: Phase-Field Crystal
desc: A Swift-Hohenberg phase-field crystal resolved to the atomic column: a hexagonal lattice nucleates out of the melt into misoriented grains stitched together by dislocation arrays, while wandering molten pools eat the crystal and it refreezes behind them and the lattice constant breathes so dislocations must climb forever; rendered as a dark-field HRTEM plate, warm bright-field with Fresnel-rimmed atom cores, an ironbow thermal map, or a blueprint of the bare defect network.

name: ODE Phase Portrait
desc: A living phase portrait of a 2D differential equation — fifteen hundred tracer particles stream along the vector field toward spirals, saddles, limit-cycles and centres, hued by speed over faint nullclines and glowing fixed points, the flow topology transforming from pendulum to Van der Pol to Duffing to predator-prey as the sections turn.

name: Phason
desc: A twelvefold dodecagonal quasicrystal of squares and 30/60-degree rhombi built live by the de Bruijn dual, drifting in perpendicular space so that phason flips keep rearranging the tiles beneath a raking light while a narrow annealing front sweeps across the plane.

name: Photoelastic Fringes
desc: White light through a stressed birefringent specimen between crossed polarizers — an Airy stress function loaded by orbiting point loads throws isochromatic rainbow fringes that crowd into tight nested families around each stress concentration as the specimen is slowly loaded and relaxed over minutes, while black isoclinic bands sweep through wherever a principal axis lines up with the polarizer; also sodium-lamp monochromatic fringes, plane-polariscope isoclinics, a clinical FEA stress map, or luminous dark-field filaments.

name: Phototropism
desc: A rank of seedlings writing down where the light has been — auxin floods each shaded flank so the apex swings toward a lamp that wanders the sky on two incommensurate rates, and because tissue goes rigid the instant it is laid down, every stem grows into a frozen graph of the light's own history while its shadow sweeps the soil beneath it.

name: Phyllotaxis Bloom
desc: A sunflower seed-head of golden-angle florets that spirals out from center and slowly rotates, blooming and wilting across sections, with a perturbable divergence angle that fractures the lattice into spiral arms, in botanical, ink-engraving, iridescent-nacre and blueprint-schematic styles.

name: Physarum Network
desc: Thousands of slime-mold agents deposit and follow chemical trails, self-organizing into a living reticulated vein network that thickens into highways and dissolves back into filigree; renders as bioluminescent neon, warm coral, sumi ink on paper, cyan blueprint, or thermal.

name: Pinwheel Tiling
desc: A Conway-Radin pinwheel aperiodic tiling where right triangles deflate into five smaller copies and end up at infinitely many angles, hued by orientation and slowly rotating like a hypnotic non-periodic mosaic.

name: Pipework
desc: A piping isometric of a process unit — a header runs the length of the deck and branch lines break off and pick their way through three dimensions in Manhattan legs, elbowing round each other with real occlusion, flanged and valved and tagged, while coloured flow packets chase down every service and the whole spool sways gently on its axonometric axis.

name: Pixel Sort Databend
desc: Asendorf-style pixel sorting: a colourful synthesised field is databent by sorting contiguous brightness-threshold spans into melting glitch smears, the sort window drifting on the clock so the image perpetually re-melts — full-spectrum databend, VHS chroma-bleed, mono static, thermal, or channel-split chromatic.

name: Plasma Globe
desc: A Tesla plasma globe crackling with 8-14 white-hot branching lightning bolts that fork and re-strike to new angles across a glowing violet-cyan orb, filaments reaching edge-to-edge over a near-black void.

name: Domain-Warp Plasma
desc: A luminous domain-warped fBm plasma nebula that boils and drifts edge to edge, its warped noise coordinates folding bright cloud-bands through an iq cosine palette; renders as cosmic nebula, thermal false-color, sumi ink-wash, oil-slick iridescence, or a cyan contour blueprint.

name: Predator-Prey Chase Waves
desc: A hunt spread across a whole landscape and held still enough to look at — prey breaks out into bright arcs wherever the ground is good, the predator crescent runs each arc down from behind and eats a hole through it, and prey floods back into the emptied hole from the flank, the two populations chasing each other forever as false-colour channels that never once settle.

name: Prism Diffraction
desc: Rippling spectral bands split by a prism, their rainbow edges fringing with chromatic dispersion as the diffraction pattern flows and warps; renders as sharp dispersed spectrum, smooth oil-film, single-hue silver diffraction, thermal, or ink contour bands.

name: Quasicrystal Interference
desc: A sum of N evenly-angled plane-wave cosine gratings that interfere into a slowly shimmering aperiodic quasicrystal whose N-fold symmetry ratchets up section by section, rendered as spectral iq-cosine bloom, thermal false-color, cyan blueprint contours, sumi ink duotone, or a clustered-dot halftone screen.

name: Radar PPI
desc: A surveillance radar plan-position indicator: the sweep rakes around the tube painting a hot coastline, drifting weather cells and labelled aircraft tracks into the phosphor, and the whole return decays behind it into a long trailing wedge while the bearing scale, bezel and readouts sit engraved on a lit console panel.

name: Rauzy Fractal Tiling
desc: The Tribonacci Rauzy fractal — a jagged three-lobed quasicrystalline region tiled by three self-similar copies of itself in magenta, teal and gold, slowly rotating and re-colouring as the aperiodic mosaic breathes.

name: Rayleigh-Taylor
desc: Heavy fluid resting on light fluid — the most impatient arrangement in physics — where every dimple in the interface runs away into a falling spike, bubbles of light squeeze up between them, and each plunging tip shears itself into the iconic mushroom cap before the whole front shreds into a churning mixing layer that is fed from above and below and never settles; as two dyed fluids, the vorticity the spikes deposit, ironbow thermal, sumi ink wash, or spectral false-color.

name: Reaction-Advection
desc: Gray-Scott Turing chemistry running inside a moving fluid — every step the reagents are advected along a divergence-free curl field before they react, so the spots are never allowed to sit still: they stretch into streaming comet filaments, shear, fold and tear apart, then re-nucleate downstream while feed and kill march the chemistry through spots, worms and mitosis over minutes; vivid streaming reagents, ironbow thermal, edge-lit radiograph, verdigris patina on bronze, or silky graphite.

name: Reaction-Diffusion
desc: A bold Gray-Scott Turing pattern that grows and divides forever, deep-ground coral veins and mitotic spots blazing in saturated teal, magenta and gold through a high-contrast palette LUT, with bone, ironbow-thermal, moss and a mono ink-maze contour mode.

name: Rep-Tile Inflation
desc: The chair rep-tile inflating and deflating without end — every L-tromino splits into four half-size copies of itself, the substitution depth breathing so the pavement resolves into finer and finer generations and merges back while the whole plane drifts.

name: Rhizosphere
desc: A cutaway of living soil packed with root — several plants drive multiple primary axes down through the O, A, B and C horizons hunting water, laterals fanning off to a fourth order until the profile is a dense mat, root hairs and mycorrhizal fuzz hazing every tip, while rain fronts visibly percolate downward through crumb aggregates and pores and generations germinate and senesce.

name: Rhombille
desc: A plane of tumbling blocks cut from the rhombille tiling — three rhombi to a hexagon, shaded as the three faces of a cube — with a reversal front sweeping across so the whole field turns inside out behind it, every block popping from raised to hollow as the seam glints past.

name: Ripple Tank
desc: A coarse-grid wave-equation ripple tank where two-to-four vibrating dippers radiate expanding circular wavefronts that cross into shimmering interference caustics while bass drops splash fresh rings, rendered as blue-green caustic water, ironbow thermal, oscilloscope phosphor, blueprint contour, or liquid mercury chrome.

name: Risograph Press
desc: A two-ink risograph press caught mid-run: each drum prints its own artwork through its own rotated halftone screen, the registration drifting a hair out and back while roller banding crawls down the sheet and the paper shows through everywhere the ink is not.

name: Rorschach Bloom
desc: A crisp bilaterally-symmetric inkblot: hard-edged organic lobes, tendrils and satellite droplets threshold out of a fractal-noise field, pool dark at their wet bleeding rims, hold, then perpetually morph into a new blot — deep indigo/oxblood ink bleeding into off-white paper.

name: Rose Window
desc: A backlit Gothic cathedral rose window of radial N-fold stone tracery cradling roundels of ruby, sapphire, emerald and gold stained glass that slowly rotate while a drifting backlight glows and the jewels recolour by section.

name: Rossler Attractor
desc: The Rossler attractor integrated tens of thousands of steps per frame into a self-rotating fading density buffer, its single-scroll spiral stretching and folding into a Mobius ribbon that glows deep-blue in-plane and hot-orange at the fold, rendered as spiral-fold, iridescent plasma, molten ember, cryo ice, or a graphite pencil study.

name: Rock-Paper-Scissors Lattice
desc: Three species locked in a cyclic dominance loop — each one voids its prey, floods bare ground and simply swaps places with whoever it meets — so no one can ever win and the plate stays alive as entangled rotating domains, mobility widening the spiral arms until biodiversity nearly crashes and a rescue invasion lands a fresh colony on the dead ground.

name: Aeolian Dunes
desc: An overhead granular sand landscape where fine wind-ripple trains and barchan crests crawl slowly downwind under a low raking light that carves crest shadows, branching and merging across the frame.

name: Abelian Sandpile
desc: The Bak-Tang-Wiesenfeld abelian sandpile grows grain by grain from a fixed central pour into its iconic self-similar mandala of nested squares and diamonds, exact integer heights 0-3 rendered through a hard four-colour LUT so every crisp fractal boundary reads razor-sharp across indigo-blue-gold-white spectral, blackbody thermal, copper-oxide patina, clean grayscale, and glowing neon-edge looks.

name: Schlieren
desc: Schlieren photography of an invisible medium — buoyant thermal plumes shed off pulsing burners and roll into turbulence, made visible only by their refractive-index GRADIENT as a knife edge at the focus cuts the deflected light into ghostly signed grey-on-grey; switchable to rainbow-filter schlieren, a caustic-edged shadowgraph, Mach-Zehnder interference fringes, or ironbow thermal.

name: Scree Slope
desc: A cliff shatters itself into the apron below it — freeze-thaw pries blocks off the exposed face in bursts, they run down the couloirs and come to rest where the slope slackens, so talus cones splay out and the clasts fall-sort coarse toward the toe; the massif keeps rising and a stream keeps eating the foot of the pile, so the face never retreats to rest.

name: Screenprint Pull
desc: A proof building on the press bed — the squeegee drags a bead of thick opaque spot ink across the mesh and lays another hard-cut stencil down, flooded ridges and starved bald patches streaking along the pull, pinholes where the ink never got through, the oldest coats sinking into the chipboard as fresh ones go over the top.

name: Screw Dislocation
desc: A crystal face growing on its screw dislocations: because a screw turns the surface into a helicoid its step can never grow out, so it winds up into a spiral that pumps terraces outward forever, co-rotating cores braiding into double spirals while opposed pairs close into nested loops, and drifting supersaturation makes the terraces meander and bunch into macrosteps; rendered as Nomarski differential-interference relief, climbing interference orders, luminous risers in dark field, or a blueprint of the step contours.

name: Shear Bands
desc: A packing of grains under compression, where the load refuses to spread out evenly — it finds a few paths and rides them, so a sparse blazing network of force chains carries almost everything while its neighbours idle, and strain refuses to stay uniform too, localising into inclined seams where grains climb over each other and the packing loosens until it can no longer hold anything, so the chains route around the band and it goes dark: force network, sand under a lamp, false-colour DEM, contact-graph schematic or a CT slice.

name: Side-Scan Sonar
desc: A towed side-scan sonar record unrolling forever: two acoustic swaths either side of the black water-column gap, sand-ripple fields shading bright on the slopes that face the fish, and boulders and wrecks throwing long black acoustic shadows away from nadir while range scales and fix marks scroll down the paper.

name: Chaos Game
desc: The chaos game plays itself out in glowing vertex-hued dust — a jumping point accretes a Sierpinski gasket that morphs through carpet, pentaflake, Vicsek and a restricted-square fractal as it slowly rotates, rendered as spectral dust, ember, ice, molten gold, or dark sumi ink on paper.

name: Slit-Scan Time Smear
