desc: A slit-scan / rolling-shutter time-smear where every column samples a drifting colourful noise-stripe field at a different moment, pulling motion into liquid diagonal taffy ribbons — spectral chromatic smear, VHS chroma-split warp, infrared thermal, soft aurora curtains, or high-contrast mono film.

name: Rising Smoke
desc: A buoyant column of curl-noise particles born at the base and rising into billowing plumes and vortices, warm amber embers cooling to grey-violet dispersal, or colored vapor, volcanic ash, pale ghost, and graphite pencil-flow.

name: Snowflake Growth
desc: Reiter's hexagonal snowflake cellular automaton — vapor diffuses across a hex lattice and freezes onto a growing seed, spontaneously blooming a unique six-fold dendritic ice crystal that glitters and slowly turns, then dissolves so a fresh seed can grow.

name: Soliton Web
desc: The KP-II soliton web computed from its exact tau function — solitary shallow-water waves that ride as straight luminous crests, meet at resonant Y- and X-junctions, cross straight through one another and emerge intact with nothing but a phase shift, the whole web of ridges and tinted plane-wave cells continuously rearranging as the phases drift; a sunlit lagoon with foam crests, a flat-celled tropical curve, tau-potential interference fringes, ironbow thermal, or sumi brush on paper.

name: Space-Filling Curve
desc: A Hilbert space-filling curve draws itself as one continuous glowing thread with a spectrum gradient running along its arclength, a luminous comet-head sweeping the lattice while the whole figure slowly rotates, breathes and undulates; renders as rainbow gradient-thread, CRT phosphor, cyan blueprint, gold PCB circuitry, or sumi ink on paper.

name: Space Frame
desc: A structural plate of a two-plane space frame carrying rolling loads — every member is solved by relaxation and lit by its own axial force, blue in compression and red in tension, the whole span visibly sagging and shivering under the wheels while a deflection diagram traces the bottom chord below and callouts count the kilonewtons.

name: Speckle
desc: Laser light off a rough surface — every point on the diffuser scatters with its own random phase and the wavefronts fight to a standstill, granulating the whole field into fully-developed speckle whose grain size is set by the pupil that collects it; the diffuser creeps, so the speckle either boils in place or rides bodily across the frame, and in the interferometry styles a loaded object's deformation writes itself across the grain as correlation fringes.

name: Spectrogram Waterfall
desc: A scrolling audio-waterfall spectrogram where drifting synthetic formants, harmonic combs and diagonal chirp-sweeps burn magma-hot ridges into a dark ground and cascade downward through frequency-time, driven by live FFT when present.

name: Spicules
desc: The burning prairie — the sun's edge in H-alpha is not an edge but grass, a forest of chromospheric jets launched up the magnetic field, climbing, hanging and draining back down the same field line they came up, crowded into bushes along the network boundaries and combed over by the field while the disk below them streams with fibrils; in the doppler style the colour is the real observable, so the forest sorts itself into blue jets climbing toward you and red ones falling away.

name: Spinodal Decomposition
desc: Cahn-Hilliard spinodal decomposition — an unstable alloy quenched below its miscibility gap unmixes into two phases that then coarsen for minutes, domains swallowing their neighbours and interfaces straightening, while the conserved mean composition walks the morphology from isolated droplets through a bicontinuous labyrinth to inverted droplets and back; rendered as an etched metallographic section, Nomarski interference relief, two-ink riso, ironbow thermal, or sumi ink.

name: Spirograph Roulettes
desc: Four to seven scattered hypotrochoid and epitrochoid roulettes each wind hundreds of loops into dense rosettes, their gear ratios drifting so the luminous multi-hue flowers bloom, precess and interlock into edge-to-edge moire on a dark field.

name: Spirolateral Weave
desc: Nested turtle spirolaterals whose increasing-length segments turn a drifting angle into interlocking symmetric star-polygon lattices, layering multi-hue glowing polylines into a slowly re-weaving, rotating luminous mandala.

name: Squared Square
desc: Squaring the strip forever — unequal squares drop into the lowest notch of a rising skyline and lock together with no gap and no overlap, each still glowing with the heat of being laid and each stamped with its own order, the finished dissection scrolling away beneath.

name: Ink Fluid
desc: Jos Stam stable-fluids dye advection on a coarse curl-noise velocity grid: saturated pigment blooms billow, curl and shear through water, rendering as colorful ink-in-water, luminous neon smoke, ironbow thermal schlieren, velocity-mapped spectral iridescence, or a blueprint vector-field schematic.

name: Stairwell
desc: The view straight down an endless stairwell shaft — rectangular landings nest and pinwheel away into the dark, treads and balustrades spiralling floor after floor while a band of light wanders up and down the void and the whole shaft slowly precesses.

name: Hyperspace Starfield
desc: A parallax starfield accelerating into hyperspace, cool blue-white stars streaming outward from a drifting vanishing point as elongating light-streaks over a faint nebula glow, the warp speed breathing on the clock and section arc.

name: Living Stipple
desc: Thousands of luminous stipple dots swarm and re-cluster across a bold high-contrast fBm density field, streaming along its drifting contours like a breathing pointillist engraving that fills the frame in spectral, ink, gold-dust, blueprint or neon inks.

name: De Jong Attractor
desc: A luminous Peter de Jong strange attractor accumulated into a rolling log-density histogram and tone-mapped into a filamentary cloud whose coefficients slowly morph as the whole form drifts and rotates, rendered as additive plasma glow, thermal false-color, sumi ink on paper, a cyan density blueprint, or pearlescent iridescent nacre.

name: Stratigraphy
desc: A subsiding basin writes its own record in cross-section — sea level rises and falls over minutes while sediment supply lags behind, so facies belts interfinger and march sideways across the plate, coal swamps drown into shale and shoal back into barrier sand, and every fall strips the top off in a truncation surface; the column scrolls downward forever, sagging into its syncline as it buries.

name: Street Canyon
desc: A true two-point-perspective street canyon crabbing forward between towers — blocks converge on one vanishing point while their end walls converge on a second far off-frame, lit windows scatter across the facades, and a raking sun azimuth crawls from wall to wall over minutes.

name: String Art Envelopes
desc: Curve-stitching string art: hundreds of straight translucent threads laced between nails on rotating circles weave into glowing cardioid, nephroid and mystic-rose envelope curves whose connection offset drifts so the caustics endlessly breathe and morph; renders as multi-hue neon, gold-silk, cyan blueprint, spectral rose, or white thread on black.

name: Recursive Subdivision
desc: A canvas that recursively splits into a De Stijl mosaic, growing and reshuffling over each section while a raking light sweeps the grid and accent cells snap on the beat.

name: Subway Platform
desc: An endless subway platform seen from standing height with the vanishing point hard off-centre — grimed tile bands and lit advert boxes creep past on the left, rails and sleepers converge on a black tunnel arch, and every half-minute a train boils out of it, headlight first, and sweeps the frame.

name: Sunspot
desc: A sunspot held under an observatory's white-light plate — the photosphere boiling everywhere in granules that brighten, shoulder their neighbours aside and are replaced, until a rope of field throttles the convection and the gas there cools and goes dark: a stippled umbra split by a light bridge, ringed by penumbral filaments that each carry a dark core down their length while the Evershed flow runs brightness out along them; also a crimson H-alpha spot trailing superpenumbral fibrils, a signed magnetogram where the light is gone and only the field remains, a heliograph engraving, or ironbow thermal.

name: Superformula Bloom
desc: Nested Gielis superformula supershapes bloom and morph through flowers, stars, gears and sea-anemone blobs as glowing concentric contours that slowly drift and counter-rotate; renders as neon bloom, sumi ink-botanical, oil-slick iridescence, a cyan schematic blueprint, or brushed chrome.

name: Synoptic Chart
desc: A surface weather analysis redrawing itself forever: depressions are born in the west, deepen, throw cold and warm fronts that occlude as they age, and fill as they run off the east margin, while the isobars knot around them, rain shading sweeps the warm sector and every station plots its own wind barb across the pressure gradient.

name: Talbot Carpet
desc: The near field behind a diffraction grating, sliced open along the optical axis — light that has only just left the slits keeps re-assembling itself into perfect copies of the grating at every Talbot distance, and the space between fills with the fractal lattice of fractional revivals, half-period ghosts and doubled-frequency images known as the Talbot carpet; because the self-imaging depth runs with wavelength, white light lays each colour's carpet at its own scale and the whole weave goes chromatic as the camera flies down the axis.

name: Tearing
desc: A tear running through a fibrous sheet, held in macro with the camera riding the tip so it never finishes — the mat whitens under strain ahead of the crack, separates along one ragged path whose two deckle edges interlock exactly because they were once the same edge, and behind it single fibres bridge the widening gap, going slack, drawing taut, then snapping and recoiling into dangling pull-out; cream rag paper, carbon-fibre laminate under an electron beam, translucent parchment, backlit mat or a flat conservator's loss diagram.

name: Tendril Climb
desc: A creeper hunting its way up a trellis and never finishing — free apices circumnutate in live searching sweeps until a tendril finds a batten and coils onto it, the stem zigzags up the support shedding fluttering leaves, and old growth dries to gold and is pruned so a new shoot can take the freed lattice; a pool of eighteen staggered generations, so something is always germinating, always racing, always senescing.

name: Tesseract
desc: A rotating 4D hypercube whose 32 glowing struts turn the inner cube inside-out through the outer one, stereographically projected and hued by 4D depth as w-shifted rainbow glow, neon wire, gold chrome, technical blueprint, or crystalline ice.

name: Thomas Attractor
desc: Thomas' cyclically-symmetric strange attractor traced as a slowly turning labyrinth of glowing looping tubes, tens of thousands of iterates splatted and depth-shaded through a teal-to-gold palette on dark, breathing open and closed as it rotates.

name: Thunderhead
desc: A convective storm cell towering over a dark plain — cauliflower turrets boil upward out of the base, pile into a sheared anvil that streams downwind, hang mammatus lobes from its underside and drag a rain shaft to the horizon, the whole cell lit from within by a slow diffused sheet-glow that never flashes.

name: Times-Table Cardioid
desc: A modular-multiplication string envelope where N points on a circle wire i to i*k, the multiplier creeping forever so the caustic sweeps through cardioid, nephroid and multi-lobed rose envelopes as luminous index-hued chords over dark.

name: Travertine
desc: Warm banded stone the water is still building — folded calcite bedding runs cream through buff and ochre to rust, vug cavities open along the porous layers where the dissolution front passes, hard beds stand proud of soft ones under a slow raking light, and thin films of spring water creep down the face, darkening the stone and igniting the wet facets.

name: Truchet Flow Tiles
desc: An infinite grid of quarter-arc Truchet tiles wired into glowing maze-like loops that scroll and slowly re-roll so the labyrinth perpetually rewrites itself, rendered as multi-hue neon weave, copper circuit traces, leaded stained glass, black-and-white op-art, or braided rope.

name: Turing Horns
desc: An anisotropic Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion field driven into the labyrinth regime, its directional-diffusion tensor rotating continuously so warm coral-bone ridges perpetually reorganize between fingerprint, brain-coral and branching horn morphologies; renders as coral-horn, ink fingerprint on cream, ironbow thermal, pink-grey brain-coral, or teal bio-membrane.

name: Ulam Prime Spiral
desc: Integers spiral out from the center and the primes ignite as glowing residue-hued dots, exposing the eerie diagonal streets where primes cluster while concentric activation waves ripple outward and a scanning highlight rakes the diagonals.

name: Rib Vaulting
desc: Looking up into a gothic rib vault as the nave walks past overhead — true groin-vault geometry springs from the piers, diagonal ribs cross at a carved boss in every bay, ashlar courses band the severies and a slow light crawls the stone from clerestory to clerestory.

name: Leaf Venation
desc: Space-colonization vein networks branch toward scattered auxin sources and thicken into a glowing leaf-coral-river tree that fills the frame then reseeds, rendered as gold hyphae on teal-black, botanical green veins, a cyanotype blueprint, crimson nerve dendrites, or sumi ink-roots.

name: Viscous Fingering
desc: A Hele-Shaw cell in close-up: air forced into viscous oil between two glass plates cannot hold a smooth front, so the interface buckles into Saffman-Taylor fingers that stretch, widen and tip-split forever while surface tension fights to keep them fat — injected as glowing dye in dark oil, false-color pressure interferogram, bitten sumi litho plate, electroplated metal dendrite, or ironbow thermal flux.

name: Voronoi Cells
desc: A living mosaic of drifting Voronoi cells that bounce, gather and scatter to the beat, rendered as leaded stained glass, crystalline shards, translucent biological membranes, a thermal false-color heat field, or a bare glowing edge network.

name: Voronoi Triangles 3D
desc: A faceted crystalline field of Voronoi cells extruded into fake-3D gem facets, each triangle flat-shaded by a slowly orbiting light while the cells breathe on the beat and the whole lattice re-cuts itself every section.

name: Voronoi Shatter
desc: A coarse Worley distance-field where two-dozen drifting seed sites partition the plane into breathing polygonal cells, colored per-cell from an iq cosine palette with F2-minus-F1 crack-lines fracturing the frame like stained glass, cracked earth, iridescent soap foam, neon distance-field veins, or a white-on-blue blueprint.

name: Vortex Lattice
desc: A superfluid that cannot rotate the way ordinary matter does, so it punches an Abrikosov lattice of quantized vortices through itself — each a bottomless hole where the density hits exactly zero and the phase winds by exactly one turn — the whole crystal wheeling as a body and ringing with slow Tkachenko waves; as a luminous condensate pierced by black cores, a forked interference pattern, a raw phase pinwheel map, a grainy absorption shot, or spectral false-color.

name: Vortex Ring
desc: A ring cannon fired down a hazy tunnel, sliced through its axis: each smoke ring is a counter-rotating vortex pair that rolls its dye slug into a double spiral, and because every ring swims in the field of the one ahead they leapfrog — the trailing ring contracts, accelerates, shoots clean through the leader's throat and widens as the pair trade places, over and over; as a backlit wind-tunnel smoke study, a signed-vorticity PIV plate, sumi ink puffs, luminous spectral flux, or a cross-hatched engraving.

name: Symmetry Wallpaper
desc: A seeded harmonic motif replicated under the plane symmetry groups — mirrors, glides, 2/4/6-fold rotations — folding an ornate seamless kaleidoscopic wallpaper that drifts continuously and morphs its symmetry every section, rendered as jewel-facet ornament, gold Islamic star lattice, leaded art-nouveau glass, neon psychedelia, or two-tone woodblock.

name: Wang Tile Weave
desc: An aperiodic Wang tiling whose colored edges match across every seam and connect into continuous multi-hue pipes that flow edge-to-edge, the labyrinth slowly scrolling and re-rolling so the pattern perpetually rewrites, rendered as glossy pipe ribbons, neon tubes, copper circuit traces, leaded stained glass, or two-tone op-art.

name: Warped Lattice
desc: A modular lattice whose vertices are dragged through a drifting noise flow so the whole grid ripples, folds and heaves like a kinetic topological fabric; renders as a glowing neon wireframe, shaded solid quads, a dot lattice, a cyan blueprint, or ink on paper.

name: Watercolor Bleed
desc: Layered watercolor pigment blooms — recursively deformed organic polygons stacked in translucent multiply layers so overlaps deepen into mottled wet-edged washes that breathe and drift across warm paper; renders as jewel pigment, sunset, botanical, tonal monochrome, or sumi ink.

name: Quantum Wavefunction
desc: A 2D Schrodinger wavefunction evolving in real time, its probability density blooming into interference fringes and self-focusing lumps as the quantum phase spins through a full colour wheel, rendered as phase-hued density, thermal heat, blue-white wave fringes, spectral glow, or an x-ray greyscale.

name: Wave Terrain
desc: A drifting wave-terrain field where summed sines fold a relief surface under glowing spectral iso-contours, a shaded topographic readout traced by a bright dot orbiting a Lissajous path across the undulating landscape.

name: Weierstrass Terrain
desc: Layered parallax mountain silhouettes cut from the Weierstrass nowhere-differentiable fractal-sum-of-cosines, their crags shivering and ranges scrolling at different rates under a glowing dusk sky that drifts violet to amber.

name: Wave Function Collapse
desc: An adjacency-constrained wave-function-collapse solver that visibly collapses a grid one lowest-entropy cell at a time, weaving compatible tile-edges into a coherent luminous network of pipes and circuit paths that flows, completes, and regenerates.

name: Whispering Gallery
desc: A wave caught circling the inside of a resonator, grazing the rim at every bounce and never quite escaping — the field piles into a necklace of azimuthal lobes hugging the wall, ripples inward through its radial orders and leaks a faint evanescent breath out beyond the edge; the mode beats slowly around as its counter-propagating twin interferes, the rim breathes with thermal expansion, and deforming the cavity into a quadrupole or limacon sends the whole ray dynamics chaotic.

name: Wireworld Circuits
desc: A living luminous circuit board where electron heads trail glowing comet-tails as they race forever around auto-generated beveled conductor loops, a self-sustaining Wireworld cellular automaton rendered as cyan traces, copper PCB, green phosphor CRT, magenta neon, or gold leadframe.

name: Wood Grain
desc: The face of a sawn board running slowly past under a raking light — growth rings built from soft pale earlywood and a hard dark latewood band, dragged into whorls around the knots where branches left the trunk, and medullary ray fleck that flashes across the figure as the light moves.

name: Gouged Block
desc: A block that is never finished — the gouge keeps scooping the lights away along the contours of a drifting form, the wood's own grain and knots printing through whatever ink is left, and the roller keeps coming back over so the old cuts silt up and the whole image is cut again from underneath.

name: Word Storm
desc: A swarm of typographic particles that wanders a dark field and periodically coalesces to spell a word before scattering again, rendered as motion-streaked type, sumi ink, CMYK halftone, wireframe, RGB glitch or thermal false-color.

name: Wireframe Wormhole
desc: A pseudo-3D wireframe tunnel of deforming rings hurtling past a drifting vanishing point, rendered as vector-green wireframe, hue-cycled neon, drafting blueprint schematic, or thermal false-color depth.
